label: New network — Automatic Hydrocarbon Network
ticket:
AQD-1357: Automatic Hydrocarbon Network - NEW NETWORK | Custom Selections Reflections

Acceptance criteria:

1. New Network: Automatic Hydrocarbon Network

2. Applicable pollutants:
Methanol, Ethanol, Ethane, Ethene, Ethyne, Propane, Propene, Iso-butane, N-butane, 1-Butene, Iso-butene, Trans-2-butene, Cis-2-butene, 1,3-Butadiene, Iso-pentane, N-pentane, 1-Pentene, Trans-2-pentene, Cis-2-pentene, 2-Methylpentane, 3-Methylpentane, 2+3-Methylpentane, Isoprene, Cyclopentane, N-hexane, N-heptane, Iso-octane, N-octane, N-nonane, Benzene, Toluene, Ethylbenzene, M-xylene, P-xylene, M+p-xylene, O-xylene, 1,2,3-Trimethylbenzene, 1,2,4-Trimethylbenzene, 1,3,5-Trimethylbenzene, Acetaldehyde, Acetone

3. If any of the applicable pollutants are selected (individually or as multiple selections), 'Automatic Hydrocarbon Network' is to be included as part of the data source, displayed under 'Near real-time data from Defra'.

4. If none of the applicable pollutants are selected, 'Automatic Hydrocarbon Network' is NOT to be included as part of the data source.

gold_standard.rationale: New network addition — must cover the happy path (applicable pollutant selected → network appears), negative path (non-applicable pollutant selected → network absent), and multiple applicable pollutants selected together.
must_cover_scenarios: selecting an applicable pollutant shows Automatic Hydrocarbon Network under Near real-time data from Defra
selecting multiple applicable pollutants shows Automatic Hydrocarbon Network once
selecting a pollutant not in the applicable list does not show Automatic Hydrocarbon Network
